title: Frictionless Conversational Distribution
rules: Eliminate standard paid advertising budgets by embedding the physical product directly into natural high-visibility environments where discussions organically happen.
Seed influential distribution nodes (e.g., podcast hosts, operators) with equity or product access so their audience sees the tool in live use without a formal ad read.
Build a built-in referral loop into the packaging or delivery mechanism so every end user automatically becomes a distributor.
